_comment: Copy to identity.local.json (untracked) and fill in YOUR accounts. This is the single source for the work/personal values the guard hooks compare against and the SessionStart hook injects into context. No secrets go here — just identifiers. Empty/missing values make the rule that needs them no-op (fail open), never match-everything. connectorRoots names the two local connector registry roots (one per boundary, outside every repo); bin/connector_registry.py reads them.
